'''Garulo''' was the [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]] [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] of [[Relgar Carrae]] during the [[Cloud City Grand Prix/Legends|Cloud City Grand Prix]]. He held the record for the most [[Racer/Legends|racers]] disabled in a single [[Standard year/Legends|year]] and over the beginning of the competition.
